positive.point: Shelf tag system is a decent system for maintaining item accuracy, with some users achieving high accuracy rates.
Pro shopper system improvements make it easier to maintain status by excluding out-of-stock items from ratings.

negative.point: Issues with DoorDash orders being canceled or not fulfilled, leading to frustration and lack of timely refunds.
Customer support is inadequate, often relying on AI which fails to address issues effectively.
Problems with the pro shopper system, such as shelf tag photos not being recognized and high threshold percentages.
Orders being delivered at incorrect times, leading to potential theft or spoilage.
Dasher issues, such as confusion over order assignments and lack of partial pay for unassigned orders.
